interpretation: All 13 required workflow gates ran and passed. Twenty-four disabled duplicate instances refer to suites proven earlier in this same run; the mobile portal matrix duplicates are intentionally suppressed because its desktop project iterates all viewports. Seven dynamic organization/admin interaction instances did not find their specific DOM fixture and provide no coverage for those interactions. Their skip does not establish that no organizations or students exist. No skipped required workflow gate was found. Analytics, isolated local theme publication/import and explicitly bounded Mollie rehearsal paths were not exercised by this batch.
